summary.answer: Constructs kills, compass, WZ HUD menus, talker/VOIP and game-status children. Talker Visible requires spectator flag; full VOIP HudStart requires wzHardcore and not spectator, enemies-only HudStart AlwaysTrue and not wzHardcore. Status Right is AlwaysFalse and Left AlwaysTrue; filters split gameInformation/hudGameStat with exact HUD-left datasource. Parent HideForCodCaster and HideForSpawnSelect retain profile/show-model guards. scriptNotify dispatches create_prematch_timer or exact holding-pen hash with5000 helper duration. Close/postload precede custom WZ menu focus and quick-inventory auto-close setup5000, returns self. Source predicates and model consumers do not reconstruct VOIP network or match timer producers.

summary.answer: Builds game-status decorative panels, kills/players-left children, teammate/spectator counts and left/right endgame status lists. Nonnil aliveTeammateCount/spectatorsCount are sent directly to text. Each status display filters right-solo gameInformation versus left-solo hudGameStat, then assigns its exact endgame datasource names. Registers close, optional postload, returns self. This displays supplied data without computing ranks, population or results.
